cohort: Twelve HIV-infected pregnant women treated long-term with lopinavir/ritonavir and 12 healthy pregnant women who submitted to epidural anaesthesia with racemic bupivacaine during caesarean section.
finding: The placental transfer of both bupivacaine enantiomers was 100% higher in HIV-pregnant women treated with lopinavir/ritonavir when compared with that in healthy pregnant women receiving epidural anaesthesia for caesarean section.
